corpus.text: Cats purr when they feel content and relaxed around their owners.
Felines are solitary hunters that sleep much of the day.
A house cat's rough tongue is covered in tiny backward-facing spines.
Dogs bark to alert their owners of intruders and unfamiliar sounds.
Canines descended from wolves and were domesticated thousands of years ago.
Golden retrievers are friendly family dogs known for loyalty.
Python is a high-level programming language used for data analysis and web apps.
JavaScript runs in browsers and powers most modern interactive web pages.
Rust offers memory safety without a garbage collector through its ownership model.
Type hints in modern Python make static analysis with mypy much easier.
Neural networks learn patterns from labeled training data via gradient descent.
Transformers use self-attention layers to model long-range token dependencies.
Supervised learning requires a dataset of inputs paired with target outputs.
Cross-entropy loss is standard for multi-class classification tasks.
ETL pipelines move records from source systems into data warehouses nightly.
A star schema organizes fact tables around shared dimension tables.
Kafka streams events between services with durable, partitioned logs.
Espresso is brewed by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee.
A cappuccino layers espresso, steamed milk, and foamed milk in thirds.
Cold brew steeps coarse grounds in cool water for twelve to twenty-four hours.
